title: MOTUL 8100 POWER (12X1L)
description:
MOTUL 8100 POWERHigh Performance 100% Synthetic - ESTER Engine Oil

 High Performance 100% Synthetic - ESTER engine oil inspired from competition and specially designed for Gasoline or Diesel engines, tuned or high performance, naturally aspirated or turbocharged, indirect or direct injection, and operating over a wide range of engine revs and temperatures, in the most severe road or racing conditions.  

 **Official Key Features & Technical Bullet Points**

* ESTER Technology: 100% Synthetic formula derived from competition and based on Ester ensuring outstanding oil film resistance at very high temperatures for maximum engine power and torque, as well as maximum wear protection.  
* API SP Rated & LSPI Protection: Meets API SP standards to protect modern downsized, direct-injected turbocharged engines against the risk of Low Speed Pre-Ignition (LSPI).
* Biofuel & E85 Compatible: Exclusive formula is fully compatible with biofuels (especially Ethanol E85), LPG, CNG, and modern exhaust after-treatment systems (catalytic converters and particulate filters).
* Pressure & Temperature Stability: Maintains stable oil pressure and superior oxidation resistance across severe road driving and track use.
